title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・我が君の凱旋

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And here's Air Groove, in an awe-inspiring burst of speed! I can't believe it! She's overtaken Silence Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
text_block_list.text: Woo! Air Groove, you're the bomb! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text: Oh my goodness! Air Groove, that was mind-blowing! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Em-press! Em-press! Em-press! Em-press! Em-press! Em-press!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes. I…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (I believe that was a worthy challenge.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You were astounding. …You completely outclassed me this time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It's because you paved the way ahead of me… Because you were stronger than anyone else…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's why I could challenge you with every last ounce of energy I had.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll never forget this race for as long as I live.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Me neither.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'll never forget the sight of you dashing ahead of me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Let's race again someday. We'll have a rematch even more exciting than this one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove comes back amidst deafening cheers resounding all around.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I won. I did it this time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's right.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You've always believed in me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Thank you.
